_doc: Map 2 (Totenhafen) settings not in the generic tables (MAPS.md Map 2, DECISIONS T-036). power: the Pumpenschalter in the pump room (PowerSwitch config_table map02). tide: the Pen Hall water (gravelight/maps/map02_totenhafen/tide_controller.gd): high tide on every round divisible by every_rounds from min_round, rising over rise_seconds at that round's start and falling over fall_seconds at the next round's start, between low_y and high_y; anyone inside a flood box and below the surface + 0.4 wades (players: the enemies.json status player_status, refreshed every tick; zombies: the frost slow zombie_slow); the named spawns switch while flooded; the Operator reads the forecast the round before (vo_warn), then vo_rising / vo_falling. zones/doors/roster: the zone graph the generator builds (tests/unit/test_map02_data.gd checks it against map02.tscn, enemies.json and weapons.json). ballast: the carry mechanic's data, deferred (the coffins are dressing in this pass). No exfil block: this is the last map of the campaign chain.

tide.banner_warn: SHIPPING FORECAST: high water next round

spawn_table._doc: Which spawn points exist per zone (the generator places them; the smoke test counts them). windows = barricades, ground = emerge points live from round 1, catwalk = emerge points live only at high tide.

ballast._doc: Deferred (T-036): the carry mechanic. coffin_spots are where the lead coffins stand (east apron pallets, the warhead store); crane_hook is the drop point that would power the pumps; carry_status is the enemies.json status a carrier gets.
